description: Financial Intelligence. Data-Driven Decisions. Finance and data analytics, IFRS/XBRL, audit/PCAOB, ISSB/ESRS, professional accounting and research workflows; advisory only.

interface.longDescription: Finance & Data Analytics AI: financial intelligence, data-driven decisions, financial reporting (IFRS/XBRL), audit (PCAOB), sustainability (ISSB/ESRS), professional accounting and evidence-based research. Educational and advisory tools; no professional endorsement, assurance opinion, live data access or verified research replication unless independently evidenced.
defaultPrompt: Compare ACCA, AICPA CPA, IIA CIA, IMA CMA and ACFE CFE guidance for a fictional case, citing the actual official source.
Compare public PwC, EY, KPMG and Deloitte IFRS guidance with the governing standard for the requested year.
Find FT50/AJG4 accounting studies and identify any actually available open replication code, dataset licences and linked theses.

publication.release_notes: V3.7 adds offline Decimal financial calculation, evidence-status tagging, input validation, and local tests; no live filing access or Claude runtime certification.
